title: unified-rollouts: staged canary + shadow + A/B autorollback enhancements
author: Maya Patel
description: Motivation: improve safety and observability for staged canary + shadow + A/B rollouts and make automated rollback decisions more robust in the presence of transient signal noise. This PR implements: 1) staged probing window for shadow traffic that can be configured per-rollout to reduce noisy probes during traffic ramp; 2) quorum-based metric aggregation across replica groups for more stable rollback decisions in A/B experiments; 3) a pluggable quarantine stage so failing probes can be isolated without immediate global rollback; 4) additional telemetry and tracing hooks to link rollout decisions to trace IDs and per-prompt evals. The description below lists changes, rationale, and verification steps. Checklist: - [x] Design review complete (ENG-2412) - [x] Unit + integration tests for rollout engine - [x] End-to-end smoke tests for canary + shadow paths - [x] Observability dashboards added - [x] Docs update in redwood-docs/examples/rollouts (follow-up PR includes full user guide) Related: builds on work from ENG-1987 (rollback engine refactor) and touches runtime scheduling (scheduling.go), rollout controller (rollout_controller.go), and observability (metrics/rollout_metrics.go). Does not change public API surface for rollout CRDs; rollout config adds optional fields with defaults for backwards compatibility.
commits: Initial staged probing window + quarantine stage implementation
Add quorum-based metric aggregator and voting logic
Wire tracing IDs through rollout decision path and add telemetry tags
Unit tests for quorum aggregator and quarantine logic
Integration tests exercising canary + shadow + A/B workflows
Fix flake in rollout e2e by increasing probe timeout and adding stability guard
Add dashboard panels and alert rules for rollout regressions
Docs: examples/rollouts minimal usage note (link to follow-up)
review_comments: Leo Chen (review): Overall looks solid. Two main asks: make quorum thresholds configurable per-metric and add a guard that requires at least one full evaluation window before authoring a rollback decision.
Maya Patel (author): Added per-metric quorum config and implemented evaluation window guard. See quorum_aggregator.go changes for defaults and overrides.
Ava Martinez (review): Observability LGTM, but can we add a sample Grafana panel for probing latency vs error-rate to help SRE triage?
Maya Patel (author): Added dashboard JSON and example alert rule. Also added trace tags so alerts include rollout_id and probe_id.
Samir Rao (review): Found a race when rollback and canary scale happen concurrently in rollout_controller.go; suggested using an optimistic token to serialize state transitions.
Maya Patel (author): Fixed race by introducing stateTransitionToken in controller; added unit test that reproduces the previous contention scenario.
CI (comment): integration pipeline failed on first run due to flake in e2e staged canary test; re-run succeeded after increasing probe timeout.
Leo Chen (approval): Approving — good coverage and telemetry. Please follow up with docs PR with migration notes for edge-case configs.

release_notes: Enhancement: Staged probing window for shadow traffic to reduce noisy probes during ramp-ups (configurable per-rollout).
Enhancement: Quorum-based metric aggregation for A/B experiments to reduce false-positive rollbacks.
Enhancement: Quarantine stage to isolate failing probes without immediate global rollback.
Observability: New rollout telemetry and Grafana panels linking rollout decisions to trace IDs and probe IDs.
Compatibility: No breaking changes; rollout config adds optional fields with sensible defaults.
testing_notes: Unit tests added for quorum aggregator and quarantine stage. Integration smoke tests for canary + shadow + A/B workflows included in ci/integration. Manual verification steps: 1) apply examples/rollouts/ab-experiment.yaml, 2) simulate degraded metric on candidate model replicas using tests/rollout/tools/sim_probe, 3) confirm quarantine stage isolates failing replica group and global traffic remains on baseline until quorum conditions met.
